apiBase.description: Gateway API base URL used by the example component. Leave it as default unless you have a specific reason to change it.

locale.description: Locale used by the example component. Please bind with 'locale' property of the session props to ensure synchronization with the Ignition session locale.

theme.description: Theme used by the example component. Please bind with 'theme' property of the session props to ensure synchronization with the Ignition session theme.
